name: mooncg
description: A simpler, modular broadcast graphics framework.

scripts.build: tsc -b && pnpm --filter @mooncg/sdk run build:browser && pnpm --filter @mooncg/dashboard run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/dashboard && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p packages/cli/test/fixtures/typed
scripts.dev: pnpm build && node packages/cli/dist/main.js dev --bundles-dir examples
